title: XML document loaded with external entities enabled (csharp)
description: The code loads a document with XDocument.Load without disabling DTD processing. An XML input can then declare an external entity that reads a local file or an internal URL, and the parsed value carries the content back to the caller.
remediation: Load with DTD processing disabled and a resolver that refuses external resources, for example XmlReader with DtdProcessing.Prohibit.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the load without inspecting the reader settings.
